newsitem.title: DUBAI: Quake hits northern Iran, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits northern Iran, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.5 on the Richter scale hit the northern Iranian city of Gorgan on Tuesday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It said the quake, which shook the Gorgan region at 2.24 a.m. (2254 GMT on Monday), had its epicentre 300 km (185 miles) northeast of the capital Tehran.
Two earthquakes of comparable strength jolted southern Iran on Monday, including one in the port city of Bandar Abbas. There were also no reports of casualties or damage.
A force four earthquake is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
Earthquakes hit Iran regularly. The worst recorded one, measuring 7.3 on the Richter scale, killed 35,000 people in a densely populated area near the Caspian coast in 1990.
